general_notes: All services write logs to a centralized log storage (ELK).
The main database is PostgreSQL, with separate instances for payment-service and billing-service.
Payments often experience external provider errors (timeout, 5xx, invalid credentials).
notification-service may degrade when external SMTP/SMS providers have issues.
reporting-service puts extra load on the DB with long analytical queries.

services.name: api-gateway
services.description: Receives external HTTP requests from clients and routes them to internal services.
known_risks: Returns 504 Gateway Timeout when an upstream service responds too slowly.

services.name: payment-service
services.description: Creation and processing of payment transactions.
known_risks: External provider errors: timeout, 5xx, invalid credentials.
Slows down when its PostgreSQL instance is overloaded.

services.name: notification-service
known_risks: Degrades when external SMTP/SMS providers have issues.

services.name: reporting-service
known_risks: Long analytical queries put extra load on the DB (see INC-102).
